title: Classwise permanence for weakly reversible mass-action systems

result.label: Classwise permanence for weakly reversible mass-action systems
result.statement: Proves the permanence conjecture for every finite weakly reversible mass-action system with fixed positive rate constants. Every positive stoichiometric compatibility class, even an unbounded one, has a common compact convex forward-invariant absorbing set. All positive trajectories in that class therefore eventually share positive lower and finite upper concentration bounds.
